A very nice surprise
Oct 2026 • Couples
We wanted a break from the local food, after nearly 10 days in Vietnam, and opted for a pizza place. We didn’t regret it! We ate a very good pizza in the heart of Huè; it was good beyond our expectations and we are very picky with pizza, being italian. At Pizz.Ā you can also find a very nice staff, which makes your experience even more enjoyable. We were waited by Sammy, a very kind and professional person and very enthusiastic about having people from other places around. We recommend this place for a pleasant supper out in Huè.
